scope: Allow new machine-silver collection and a public-source pilot, not automatic release for student training.
generation_budget: 2048 output tokens initially; one retry at 4096 only after finish_reason=length. All 43 such control retries retained separately. Never retry semantic disagreement until it becomes agreement.
evidence: All citations must be literal visible substrings or exact existing scalar JSON field:value pairs. No fuzzy matching, invented observations or inferred arithmetic accepted as a quote.
limitations: The control labels are interpreter-derived explicit-policy labels, not a representative estimate of real-world corpus annotation quality.
Conditioned precision and accepted-case counts must be reported with both-class coverage; zero observed control errors is not proof of zero label noise.
Evidence filtering still accepts safe cases more often than unsafe cases; monitor per-source and per-class retention.
Keep the old nonthinking collection and its quality stop separate; do not silently reuse its labels.
Before training, review the public-source pilot, inspect source/label confounding, retain all conflicting and uncertain cases separately, and preserve evaluation exclusions.
